summary.text: Blanca Rubio was elected in November 2016 to represent California's 48th Assembly District, which includes West Covina, Baldwin Park, Glendora, Covina, Azusa and Monrovia, among other communities.

paragraphs.text: Before the Assembly she spent 16 years as a teacher and over 20 years in elected office, serving on the Valley County Water Board and the Baldwin Park Unified School District.

She was born in Juarez, Mexico, and came to the United States with her parents at a young age. She received a bachelor's degree in business administration and a master's degree in education from Azusa Pacific University, and she lives in Baldwin Park.
